name: skill-matched
description: Suggests the installed skills that fit each request, and shows which skills, agents and plugin tools each reply used.

interface.shortDescription: Finds the installed skill that fits each request.
interface.longDescription: Searches every installed skill for each prompt and adds the best matches as context. Run the find-skill skill once and ask it to install the Codex hook to turn on automatic suggestions.
defaultPrompt: Set up the skill-matched hook for Codex.
Which skill should I use to review my code?
List every skill I have installed.
